name: AARON
canonical: Aaron, Israel's first high priest, an aged Hebrew elder of about eighty, weathered olive skin, a solemn dignified face, long flowing white hair and a full white beard; on the Day of Atonement stripped of his gold to a plain white linen tunic and sash, barefoot, the plain white linen mitre (turban) bound on his head, hands lifted in reverence
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
